# Support sees a slice

`customer_support.mm.churn_signal_detection.support_sees_a_slice` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Support sees the part of the relationship that went wrong, and only that part.

The queue is a biased sample by construction — it contains failures and questions and nothing else. That makes it superb at detecting deterioration and structurally incapable of measuring health, and a churn read that forgets this will call every heavy user a risk.
